_items_source: Gallery images now come from the CMS Showcase Gallery admin (admin.php?page=ah-client-stories) - set its header to Visible and add images there. "items" is intentionally empty; it's only a fallback for if that admin has none yet. NOTE: that admin only stores plain images (no per-image title/caption) and has no category field, so category tabs and captions only ever appear when this JSON fallback is in use - tag/title/subtitle/categories stay here for that fallback and as the static section header text.
title: LOOK BACK IN Time
subtitle: A few of our favourite moments capturing the heritage, stall life, and smiles over the years.
